import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

It pools min/max/avg over each footprint, then takes logsumexp over z. That lets it express 'all cells missing at z, all empty, some support at z-1', which is the landing and correctness condition. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32}

TW = 32
LH = 32
LP = 16
MH = 16
NIN = 11


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        c = spec.in_channels
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(c, 48, 1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Conv2d(48, TW, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.layer_in = nn.Conv2d(NIN, LH, 1)
        self.col_in = nn.Conv2d(TW, LH, 1)
        self.layer_proj = nn.Conv2d(LH, LP, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * LP, MH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(MH, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.normal_(o.weight, std=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TW, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        bb = F.pad(build, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        tb = F.pad(tgt, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, bb, tb], dim=2)
        hts = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zr = torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        zc = (zr + 0.5) / Z
        g0 = (zr == 0).to(obs.dtype)
        pos = torch.stack([zc, g0], dim=1).view(1, Z, 2, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([per, hts, pos], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, NIN, Y, X)

        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

        col = self.col_in(f).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LH, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LH, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.layer_in(inp) + col)
        p = self.layer_proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            hh = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(hh))
        sc = torch.cat(res, dim=1).reshape(B, Z, -1)
        place = torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
FCP = 8


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.fc_proj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, FCP, 1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(FCP * int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X), int(spec.n_place))
        nn.init.normal_(self.fc.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.fc.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f) + self.fc(F.relu(self.fc_proj(f)).flatten(1))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 32}

W = 40
HH = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_types = int(spec.n_types)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.gctx = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c4 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.h1 = nn.Conv2d(W, HH, 3, padding=1)
        self.h2 = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.n_types, 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.h2.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.h2.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(s + self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g0 = torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        x = F.relu(x + self.gctx(g0)[:, :, None, None])
        x = F.relu(x + self.c3(x))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c4(x))
        place = self.h2(F.relu(self.h1(f))).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ent_coef": 0.03, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

W = 32
HH = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.A = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(cin, 48, 1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Conv2d(48, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.gctx = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.h1 = nn.Conv2d(W, HH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head_a = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.T, 5, padding=2)
        self.head_b = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.T, 5, padding=2)
        for h in (self.head_a, self.head_b):
            nn.init.normal_(h.weight, std=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(h.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.A].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(s + self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g0 = torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        x = F.relu(x + self.gctx(g0)[:, :, None, None])
        f = F.relu(x + self.c3(x))
        h = F.relu(self.h1(f))
        pa = self.head_a(h).flatten(1)
        pb = self.head_b(h.transpose(2, 3).contiguous()).flatten(1)
        place = pa + pb
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ent_coef": 0.03, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

W = 32
D = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.A = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(cin, 48, 1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Conv2d(48, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.key = nn.Linear(W, D)
        self.val = nn.Linear(W, D)
        self.pos = nn.Embedding(self.Y * self.X, D)
        self.qry = nn.Embedding(self.A, D)
        self.abias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.A, D))
        self.out = nn.Linear(D, 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.out.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.A].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        cells = f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self.key(cells) + self.pos.weight.unsqueeze(0)
        v = self.val(cells)
        q = self.qry.weight
        att = torch.matmul(k, q.t()).transpose(1, 2) * self.scale
        att = torch.softmax(att, dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(att, v)
        h = F.relu(o + self.abias.unsqueeze(0))
        place = self.out(h).squeeze(-1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 8, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.0015, "ent_coef": 0.002, "clip_eps": 0.3}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97}

CW = 64
TW = 32
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DF = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        c = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.col = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(c, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Conv2d(64, CW, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(CW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.gctx = nn.Linear(2 * TW, TW)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(CW + TW, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.dfeat = nn.Conv2d(CW, DF, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TW + 2 * DF, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        e = self.col(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(e))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g0 = torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        f = F.relu(x + self.gctx(g0)[:, :, None, None])
        p = self.proj(torch.cat([e, f], dim=1))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        d = self.dfeat(e)
        gd = torch.cat([d.amax((2, 3)), d.amin((2, 3))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), gd], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet, and the starting architecture scored 0.000. The default recipe probably explains much of that: 131,072 steps divided by 4,096 samples per update gives only 32 PPO updates, and that is very little time to learn exact multi-brick builds. Round 1 therefore tests two things. First, the recipe: smaller rollouts give many more updates, and fewer PPO epochs buy more samples. Second, a head built around the task's structure. A placement is right when, at its landing layer L (the highest build height under the brick), every cell under the footprint is missing in the build and some cell is supported at L-1. The starting head pools column features and cannot easily represent the condition 'target filled at the max-height layer'. A head that scores each layer separately and pools each footprint with min and max can represent it, with no hand-computed features. Candidate A gives a recipe-only baseline. B tests the head under the same recipe. C runs the same head with 1 PPO epoch and about 1.75x as many samples as B.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scores 0, on dev and on training success in the last 10% of training. That holds across three recipes (32 to 208 updates, 1 to 4 epochs) and two head designs, including a layer-factored head built around the landing rule. Since nothing gets even a single exact build, these differences are not about noise. The problem looks more basic. Possibilities: (a) the world's action-index or anchor convention does not match what the aligned footprint heads assume (the task warns the world may differ); (b) the receptive field or global context is too small; (c) a recipe issue, which seems less likely after three recipes. This round hedges on (a) and (b). A adds a fully connected action head that can learn any mapping from cells to action indices. B uses a deeper 2D trunk with global context and a 3x3 per-type head that learns the anchor offset. C is a plain MLP that assumes no spatial convention at all.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and their training success was also 0. That held for conv nets, the layer-factored head, the FC head and a convention-free MLP, under 1- and 2-epoch recipes. Architecture alone is not the bottleneck, because nets that can clearly represent 'place where missing at the build height' still never finish one design. One likely cause is that the policy collapses onto DONE. Under a near-uniform policy most placements are wrong and cost reward, while pressing DONE immediately returns 0. DONE is a single, easily learned logit, so PPO can lock onto it before the placement head learns which bricks are correct. Every trial used ent_coef 0.01 and gamma 0.95. A second possibility, which the world note hints at, is a mismatch in the action-indexing or anchor convention. This round tests both. All three trials use the same anti-collapse recipe: entropy 0.03, gamma 0.99, lambda 0.95. Trial 1 is a pure-recipe control on the starting net. Trial 2 adds an orientation-robust conv head and trial 3 a convention-free attention pointer head.
analyses.4: Every trial so far scored 0.000 on dev and 0.000 on training success, with both seeds at zero. These included recipe changes, a layer-factored head, convention-free heads (FC, transposed 5x5, attention pointer), a deeper CNN and a plain MLP. Because the convention-free heads also failed, a mismatch in anchor or index convention is probably not the only cause. A correct placement needs the lowest missing layer to be the same across the footprint and equal to the brick's landing height (the maximum build height over the footprint). Per-column features plus footprint min/max pooling can express that test exactly. The likelier bottleneck is learning dynamics: a near-uniform policy over about 250 actions sharpens too slowly, and no stochastic episode ever builds exactly. This last round tests faster policy sharpening (many small updates, low entropy, wider clip) on the starting net and on a column-feature net, plus a large-minibatch, lower-lr recipe. Any result above zero beats the start.
